title: Surreal Dream Projector
description: A woman in ornate golden robes sits inside a giant blooming lotus, holding a glowing orb while reading a book. She peers through a large telescope that projects a vibrant, multi-colored dragon emerging from a swirling cosmic vortex above, surrounded by flaming ships, film reels, roses with eyes, and various surreal symbols against a deep purple night sky.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal scene of a woman in ornate golden robes sitting inside a giant pink lotus flower on dark water. She holds a glowing orb and reads a book while looking through a large brass telescope. The telescope projects a massive, colorful dragon made of flowers and flames emerging from a swirling cosmic vortex in the sky. Floating burning ship, film reels, roses with eyes, pink and yellow flowers, sharks, and birds fill the deep purple night sky with dramatic cinematic lighting.
